text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN LKPD PROBLEM-BASED LEARNING KONTEKS LAPANGAN MERDEKA BINTUHAN UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN PEMECAHAN MASALAH PESERTA DIDIK The low problem-solving ability of students is caused by the inaccurate application of media and models in learning. From this problem, a study was conducted that aims to produce a valid, practical and effective Problem-Based Learning Student Worksheet (LKPD) in the context of Bintuhan Merdeka Square on the subject of quadrilaterals to improve students' problem-solving abilities. Research and development (R&D) with the ADDIE model (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). This study involved material experts, media experts, linguists, mathematics teachers, and class VIII students of SMPN 19 Kaur in the 2025/2026 academic year. Data collection techniques include questionnaires and tests. Data analysis techniques include data analysis of validity, practicality, and effectiveness. The validation results of material experts (0.97), media experts (0.95), linguists (0.94) show that the LKPD is very valid. The practicality test obtained a score of 91.3% indicating that the LKPD is very practical. The pretest and posttest results show an N-Gain value of 0.70067 in the high category. text_snippet: EKSPLORASI GRUP DIHEDRAL PADA ORNAMEN MASJID MUNGSOLKANAS BANDUNG: SEBUAH STUDI ETNOMATEMATIKA Mathematics is often viewed as an abstract discipline disconnected from everyday life, so its connection to culture is frequently overlooked. In fact, mathematics is present in various cultural forms, one of which is through the geometric patterns found in mosque ornamentation. These patterns exhibit regularities that can be analyzed using concepts from group theory to reveal the mathematical structures they contain. This study aims to explore dihedral group structures in mosque ornamentation. The method used in this study is ethnography, with the research site located at the Mungsolkanas Mosque in Bandung, West Java, Indonesia. This ethnomathematics framework employs four key questions: “From where is the observation made?â€, “How is the observation process conducted?â€, “What are the results of the observation?â€, and “What does it mean?â€. The researcher serves as the primary instrument in data collection through triangulation techniques, namely interviews, observation, and literature review. title: KARAKTERISTIK KONSTRUKSI KONSEP KUBUS: KAJIAN KERANGKA KERJA KONSTRUKSI APOS
text_snippet: KARAKTERISTIK KONSTRUKSI KONSEP KUBUS: KAJIAN KERANGKA KERJA KONSTRUKSI APOS Indonesia’s PISA performance indicates persistent weaknesses in mathematics, with students achieving only level 2, reflecting limited conceptual understanding. This study aims to provide a detailed analysis of junior high school students’ conceptual construction of the cube concept by integrating indicators of conceptual understanding, the Certainty Response Index (CRI), and APOS theory. A total of 160 students from two junior high schools in Central Lampung Regency completed a diagnostic test, after which six representative students were selected for deeper examination through answer sheets, think-aloud protocols, and interviews. The integrated analytical framework enabled the identification of students’ comprehension levels as well as the characterization of their underlying cognitive construction processes. Findings revealed three distinct categories of conceptual construction. The first category, Misconception–Partial Construction, is characterized by students who exhibited misconceptions accompanied by APOS stages achieved only partially. title: DEVELOPMENT OF AN INTERACTIVE MATHEMATICS MODULE BASED ON PROBLEM-BASED LEARNING AND ISLAMIC VALUES
text_snippet: DEVELOPMENT OF AN INTERACTIVE MATHEMATICS MODULE BASED ON PROBLEM-BASED LEARNING AND ISLAMIC VALUES A preliminary analysis at SMA Muhammadiyah Al Amin Sorong identified limited use of interactive learning media, low student engagement, and insufficient integration of Islamic values in mathematics learning. Therefore, this study aimed to develop an interactive digital mathematics module based on Problem-Based Learning (PBL) and integrated with Islamic values for grade XI students studying regression analysis. The study employed the ADDIE development model, consisting of Analyze, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation stages. The study involved 42 eleventh-grade students, consisting of 10 students in a small-group trial and 32 students in a large-group trial. Data were collected using expert validation sheets, student response questionnaires, a single pretest-posttest assessment instrument, student activity observation sheets, and questionnaires measuring problem-solving skills and Islamic character. The module was validated by three experts in material, media, and language. The validation results showed high validity, with scores of 0.92 for media, 0.89 for language, and 0.85 for material. The practicality results showed average scores of 84% in the small-group trial

text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN BUKU AJAR BANGUN DATAR SEGIEMPAT TERINTEGRASI PROJECT BASED LEARNING BERBANTUAN MATHCITYMAP PADA KEMAMPUAN PEMECAHAN MASALAH MATEMATIS Kemampuan pemecahan masalah dibutuhkan untuk mewujudkan SDGs Pendidikan berkualitas. Kemampuan ini penting diterapkan dalam berbagai konteks, termasuk pada pembelajaran matematika. Namun, kemampuan pemecahan masalah matematis peserta didik di SMP Negeri 1 Poncowarno masih tergolong rendah. Hasil tes awal menunjukkan bahwa rata-rata skor peserta didik kelas VII B hanya mencapai 43,75. Penelitian bertujuan mengembangkan buku ajar bangun datar segiempat terintegrasi PjBL berbantuan Mathcitymap yang layak, praktis, dan efektif terhadap kemampuan pemecahan masalah matematis. Penelitian RnD dengan desain 4D yaitu define, design, develompemnt, disseminate. Populasi penelitian adalah peserta didik SMP Negeri 1 Poncowarno. Teknik pengambilan sampel menggunakan cluster random sampling. Hasil uji kelayakan yakni 94,7% termasuk kategori Sangat Layak. Hasil uji keterbacaan diperoleh rata-rata skor keterbacaan 87,8% menunjukkan mudah dipahami. Uji ketuntasan rata-rata diperoleh maka kemampuan pemecahan masalah matematis peserta didik dengan buku ajar bangun datar segi empat terintegrasi PjBL Berbantuan MathCityMap lebih dari 70. title: PENGARUH MODEL GALLERY WALK TERHADAP PEMAHAMAN KONSEP GEOMETRI MAHASISWA PGSD DITINJAU DARI GAYA BELAJAR
text_snippet: PENGARUH MODEL GALLERY WALK TERHADAP PEMAHAMAN KONSEP GEOMETRI MAHASISWA PGSD DITINJAU DARI GAYA BELAJAR The weak understanding of geometry concepts among elementary teacher education (PGSD) students has a systemic impact on the quality of mathematics learning in primary schools. This study aimed to examine: (1) the effect of the Gallery Walk model on PGSD students' geometry conceptual understanding; (2) differences in geometry conceptual understanding based on learning styles; and (3) the interaction effect between Gallery Walk and learning styles on geometry conceptual understanding. This research used a quantitative approach with a 2Ã—3 factorial design (quasi-experimental). The sample comprised 72 PGSD students selected through cluster random sampling, consisting of 36 experimental class students (Gallery Walk) and 36 control class students (conventional instruction), each grouped based on visual, auditory, and kinesthetic learning styles. Research instruments included a geometry conceptual understanding test (5 essay items, r = 0.87) and a VAK learning style questionnaire adapted from DePorter & Hernacki. title: DEEP LEARNING-BASED STUDENT WORKSHEET ON EXPONENT NUMBERS
text_snippet: DEEP LEARNING-BASED STUDENT WORKSHEET ON EXPONENT NUMBERS Student worksheets are a teaching tool commonly used learning tool in educational. However, at the research site, there were no LKPD integrating a deep learning approach, particularly regarding the topic of powers. Meanwhile, students are often found to have mathematical misconceptions that result in low conceptual and analytical abilities on this material. Studies shown that this approach is effective in improving students' analytical and conceptual skills. Therefore, this study aims to create an LKPD that integrates deep learning that is not only valid but also practical. The method employed the 4D model, involving subject matter and media experts, 29 eighth-grade students SMP Muhammadiyah 1 Gamping, and two mathematics teachers. Data were collected through needs assessment questionnaires, teacher interviews, expert evaluations, and student-teacher feedback, and were then analyzed using descriptive and quantitative methods. This LKPD is designed to strengthen conceptual understanding through activities aligned with the deep learning approach. title: DEVELOPMENT OF CONCRETE PICTORIAL ABSTRACT TEACHING MATERIALS FOR ONE VARIABLE LINEAR EQUATION MISCONCEPTIONS
text_snippet: DEVELOPMENT OF CONCRETE PICTORIAL ABSTRACT TEACHING MATERIALS FOR ONE VARIABLE LINEAR EQUATION MISCONCEPTIONS Misconceptions in solving one-variable linear equations often arise because students tend to memorize procedural rules such as moving terms across equations without understanding the underlying concept of equivalence. This study aims to develop Concrete Pictorial Abstract (CPA)-based teaching materials for one-variable linear equation material for grade VII junior high school students that are valid, practical, and effective in minimizing these misconceptions. The research employed a 4D development model consisting of the stages of define, design, develop, and disseminate. The test subjects involved 35 grade VII students and mathematics teachers at SMP Negeri 2 Sukodono. Data were collected using field notes, expert validation sheets, and practicality questionnaires. The results showed that the developed teaching materials obtained validation scores of 4.67 from learning design experts, 4.75 from media experts, and 4.92 from mathematics material experts, indicating that the teaching materials are categorized as very valid. title: PENGEMBANGAN BAHAN AJAR INTERAKTIF BERBASIS CANVA DENGAN INTEGRASI GAME, KUIS, DAN TUGAS DIGITAL PADA MATA KULIAH KALKULUS DIFERENSIAL
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN BAHAN AJAR INTERAKTIF BERBASIS CANVA DENGAN INTEGRASI GAME, KUIS, DAN TUGAS DIGITAL PADA MATA KULIAH KALKULUS DIFERENSIAL Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan bahan ajar interaktif berbasis Canva dengan integrasi game, kuis, dan tugas digital pada mata kuliah Kalkulus Diferensial. Penelitian menggunakan model pengembangan 4D (Define, Design, Develop, Disseminate. Subjek penelitian adalah 21 mahasiswa Program Studi Pendidikan Matematika, Fakultas Tarbiyah dan Ilmu Keguruan, IAIN Langsa pada tahun 2026. Proses pengembangan dilakukan melalui empat tahap. Pada tahap Define, dilakukan analisis kebutuhan dan kesulitan mahasiswa dalam memahami materi Kalkulus Diferensial. Tahap Design meliputi penyusunan peta konsep, storyboard, dan perencanaan integrasi elemen gamifikasi. Pada tahap Develop, bahan ajar diproduksi menggunakan Canva dan divalidasi oleh tiga ahli (ahli materi, ahli media, dan ahli bahasa), menghasilkan rata-rata skor validitas sebesar 89,5% (kategori sangat valid). Tahap Disseminate melibatkan implementasi bahan ajar dan uji coba pada 21 mahasiswa. Hasil uji kepraktisan menunjukkan rata-rata skor 87,08% (kategori sangat praktis). title: COMPARING STUDENTS’ PERFORMANCE IN SOLVING SYSTEMS OF LINEAR EQUATIONS WITH TWO VARIABLES BASED ON EPISTEMOLOGICAL BELIEFS
text_snippet: COMPARING STUDENTS’ PERFORMANCE IN SOLVING SYSTEMS OF LINEAR EQUATIONS WITH TWO VARIABLES BASED ON EPISTEMOLOGICAL BELIEFS Students’ difficulties in solving Systems of Linear Equations with Two Variables (SLETV) problems are often related not only to procedural understanding but also to their beliefs about knowledge and learning. This study examined differences in students’ academic performance in solving SLETV problems based on their levels of epistemological beliefs. The study used a quantitative survey design involving 70 junior high school students studying SLETV at a junior high school in South Tangerang, Indonesia. The researchers selected participants using simple random sampling from several classes taught by the same mathematics teacher. After screening, the researchers included 34 complete, valid responses in the analysis. Data were collected using the Epistemological Belief Questionnaire, which measured four dimensions of epistemological beliefs: time allocation, solution steps, conceptual understanding, and usefulness of mathematics, along with an SLETV achievement test. The data were analyzed using One-Way ANOVA and Tukey HSD post-hoc analysis. title: GENDER DIFFERENCES IN MATHEMATICAL REASONING AND MATH ANXIETY AMONG JUNIOR HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS
text_snippet: GENDER DIFFERENCES IN MATHEMATICAL REASONING AND MATH ANXIETY AMONG JUNIOR HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS Mathematical reasoning is an important skill in mathematics learning, but in reality these skills are still relatively low in many junior high school students, while the relative contribution between gender and math anxiety to these abilities has not been widely studied simultaneously. This study intends to investigate the impact of gender and math anxiety on students' mathematical reasoning ability. Mathematical reasoning ability was the dependent variable in the multiple linear regression analysis, whereas gender and mathematics anxiety were the independent factors. Before the study, data were checked for the traditional regression assumptions of normality, linearity, homoscedasticity and absence of multicollinearity. The results indicate that the regression model significantly explains the association between predictor factors and students’ mathematical reasoning abilities, explaining 47.5% of the variance (R² = 0.475). Further investigation showed that gender has a large and significant effect on mathematical reasoning abilities, whereas math anxiety had no meaningful effect. title: PENGEMBANGAN LEMBAR KERJA PESERTA DIDIK (LKPD) BERBASIS GUIDED INQUIRY UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN KOMUNIKASI MATEMATIS PESERTA DIDIK
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN LEMBAR KERJA PESERTA DIDIK (LKPD) BERBASIS GUIDED INQUIRY UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN KOMUNIKASI MATEMATIS PESERTA DIDIK Riset ini didasari oleh defisit kemampuan komunikasi matematis peserta didik dalam mengartikulasikan ide secara lisan maupun tulisan, yang diperparah oleh dominasi pembelajaran berpusat pada guru serta keterbatasan perangkat ajar yang representatif. Sebagai solusi strategis, penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengonstruksi Lembar Kerja Peserta Didik (LKPD) berbasis guided inquiry pada materi lingkaran yang memenuhi kriteria valid, praktis, dan efektif. Metodologi pengembangan mengacu pada model Plomp yang mencakup tiga fase integratif: investigasi awal, pengembangan prototipe, dan tahap penilaian. Instrumen pengumpulan data meliputi angket, lembar observasi, serta tes kemampuan komunikasi matematis. Temuan penelitian menunjukkan bahwa LKPD yang dikembangkan mencapai skor validitas rata-rata 3,46 dengan kategori sangat valid. Aspek praktikalitas pada tahap small group dan field test masing-masing memperoleh persentase 91% dan 90,09% (sangat praktis). Lebih lanjut, efikasi perangkat terbukti melalui eskalasi signifikan pada perolehan skor peserta didik antara tahap pre-test dan post-test. Secara keseluruhan, LKPD berbasis guided inquiry ini dinyatakan layak secara metodologis dan empiris

title: PENGEMBANGAN SOAL KEMAMPUAN REPRESENTASI MATEMATIS BAGI PESERTA DIDIK SEKOLAH DASAR
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN SOAL KEMAMPUAN REPRESENTASI MATEMATIS BAGI PESERTA DIDIK SEKOLAH DASAR Kemampuan representasi matematis menjadi keterampilan penting dalam pembelajaran abad ke-21 karena membantu peserta didik memahami konsep, menyelesaikan masalah, serta mengomunikasikan ide matematika melalui berbagai bentuk penyajian. Namun, kemampuan representasi matematis peserta didik sekolah dasar masih belum berkembang optimal, salah satunya karena instrumen evaluasi yang digunakan di sekolah cenderung bersifat rutin dan lebih menekankan perhitungan prosedural. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan instrumen tes kemampuan representasi matematis peserta didik sekolah dasar pada materi pecahan sederhana, khususnya perbandingan pecahan setengah dan seperempat. Penelitian menggunakan metode Research and Development (R&D) model ADDIE meliputi tahap analysis, design, development, implementation, dan evaluation. Uji coba instrumen dilakukan pada 22 peserta didik kelas III pada salah satu sekolah dasar negeri di kabupaten Bandung, Jawa Barat. title: Pengaruh Problem Based Learning berbasis Etnomatematika menggunakan Permainaan Congklak terhadap Pemahaman Konsep pada Materi Perkalian
text_snippet: Pengaruh Problem Based Learning berbasis Etnomatematika menggunakan Permainaan Congklak terhadap Pemahaman Konsep pada Materi Perkalian Matematika merupakan ilmu yang memiliki tantangan dalam pembelajaran, salah satunya yaitu rendahnya pemahaman konsep. Dalam studi ini khususnya pada materi perkalian diperlukan landasan pemahaman konsep yang kuat untuk memecahkan masalah yang berkaitan dengan kehidupan sehari hari. Tujuan studi ini untuk melihat besarnya pengaruh pemahaman konsep peserta didik pada pembelajaran problem based learning berbasis etnomatematika menggunakan permainan congklak khususnya pada materi perkalian. Studi ini menggunakan pendekatan kuasi eksperimen dengan metode non equivalent pretest-postest control group design. Studi ini melibatkan 2 kelas yang menjadi subjek yaitu kelas eksperimen (III B) dan kontrol (III A) teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan dengan mengisi angket respon pembelajaran dan alat untuk menguji data menggunakan independent sample t-test dan cohens d untuk melihat besarnya pengaruh. Hasil studi uji t-test menyatakan adanya pengaruh yang signifikan pada pembelajaran berbasis budaya terhadap pemahaman konsep, peningkatan ini terjadi karena adanya keterlibatan aktif peserta didik secara langsungÂ pada pemecahan masalah yang dilakukan dengan melibatkan masalah sehari-hari. title: IMPLEMENTASI DESAIN DIDAKTIS PADA MATERI PERSAMAAN DAN PERTIDAKSAMAAN LINIER SATU VARIABEL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN PEMAHAMAN KONSEP MATEMATIKA SISWA
text_snippet: IMPLEMENTASI DESAIN DIDAKTIS PADA MATERI PERSAMAAN DAN PERTIDAKSAMAAN LINIER SATU VARIABEL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN PEMAHAMAN KONSEP MATEMATIKA SISWA Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis efektivitas implementasi desain didaktis dalam meningkatkan kemampuan pemahaman konsep matematika siswa pada materi persamaan dan pertidaksamaan linear satu variabel (PLSV dan PtLSV). Studi ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya pemahaman konseptual siswa akibat pembelajaran konvensional yang belum mampu mengatasi learning obstacles pada materi aljabar. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dalam kerangka Didactical Design Research (DDR) dengan populasi 233 siswa kelas VII SMP Negeri 26 Bandar Lampung dan sampel 29 siswa yang dipilih secara purposive sampling. Instrumen berupa tes pemahaman konsep yang mencakup indikator menyatakan ulang konsep, mengklasifikasikan objek, menyajikan representasi matematis, memilih dan menggunakan prosedur, serta menerapkan konsep dalam pemecahan masalah. Data dianalisis menggunakan uji Wilcoxon karena distribusi tidak normal. title: EXPLORING REVERSIBLE THINKING THROUGH THE LENS OF MATHEMATICAL DISPOSITION IN SECONDARY EDUCATION
text_snippet: EXPLORING REVERSIBLE THINKING THROUGH THE LENS OF MATHEMATICAL DISPOSITION IN SECONDARY EDUCATION As students are increasingly expected to face real-world problems requiring complex analysis, higher-order thinking skills such as reversible thinking have become indispensable. The importance of integrating numeracy with cognitive and affective student traits is rising, given the ongoing challenge to elevate the performance and confidence of learners in facing mathematical tasks. This study explores the relationship between students' mathematical disposition and their reversible thinking abilities in solving numeracy-based problems. Reversible thinking, including forward thinking and reverse thinking, is essential in mathematical problem-solving. The research employed a qualitative descriptive design with a case study approach, involving six tenth-grade students at States High Schools in Nganjuk City, East Java, Indonesia, categorized into high, medium, and low mathematical disposition groups. Data were collected using mathematical disposition questionnaires, numeracy-based tests, and semi-structured interviews. title: DEEP SCAFFOLDING BASED ON RME TO REDUCE SLOW LEARNERS’ ERRORS IN NUMERACY PROBLEM SOLVING
text_snippet: DEEP SCAFFOLDING BASED ON RME TO REDUCE SLOW LEARNERS’ ERRORS IN NUMERACY PROBLEM SOLVING Slow learners often struggle with understanding problem contexts, constructing representations, and applying appropriate strategies due to limitations in working memory, processing speed, and conceptual generalization. Therefore, structured, gradual, meaningful and enjoyable assistance is needed which is linked to the experiences and lives around slow learners students, which is called deep scaffolding based on Realistic Mathematics Education (RME). This study aims to explore the implementation of Deep Scaffolding based on RME to reduce thinking errors among slow learner students in numeracy problem solving. An interpretative qualitative method with an exploratory single-case study design was employed to gain an in-depth understanding of the cognitive and affective learning processes of one selected slow learner student. Data were collected through contextual numeracy worksheets, direct observation, and semi-structured interviews guided by the mindful–meaningful–joyful scaffolding framework. title: A COGNITIVELY ORIENTED DIAGNOSTIC ASSESSMENT OF NUMERACY LITERACY: DEVELOPMENT AND EXPERT VALIDATION
text_snippet: A COGNITIVELY ORIENTED DIAGNOSTIC ASSESSMENT OF NUMERACY LITERACY: DEVELOPMENT AND EXPERT VALIDATION Numeracy literacy achievement among Indonesian students remains critically low, yet contextually situated diagnostic instruments are largely unavailable. This study develops a cognitively oriented diagnostic assessment instrument in mathematics, grounded in Sumbawa's local numeracy literacy context, for Phase D students across Grades VII, VIII, and IX. Development followed Thiagarajan's 4D framework: Define, Design, and Develop, involving observation, interviews, and curriculum analysis. The Design phase produced five integrated components test blueprints, item sets, answer keys, scoring rubrics, and interpretive guidelines differentiated across Bloom's cognitive levels (C1–C6) and anchored in local culture. Prototype I was validated by nine experts: three lecturers and two practitioner teachers per grade level, covering content, construct, and language aspects. Quantitative scores were analyzed using Aiken's V; qualitative feedback through thematic analysis. Three aspects achieved highly valid ratings across all grades (mean: 95.09%), with Aiken's V exceeding 0.80 for all items. title: TRANSITIONAL STRUCTURE OF MATHEMATICAL THINKING FROM STRUCTURAL INTUITIVE TO DEDUCTIVE WITH THE FREEMAN FRAMEWORK
text_snippet: TRANSITIONAL STRUCTURE OF MATHEMATICAL THINKING FROM STRUCTURAL INTUITIVE TO DEDUCTIVE WITH THE FREEMAN FRAMEWORK Formal thinking requires analytical skills to evaluate whether a statement is true or false. However, researchers have found that some students complete the mathematical proof process using intuitive thinking. Students who studied mathematical proof in their early semesters often struggle to construct structural proofs intuitively. Therefore, this study aims to explore students' thought processes in conducting mathematical proofs, transitioning from intuitive reasoning to deductive reasoning, and achieving correct conclusions. The research employs a qualitative descriptive method, validated by experts in mathematical proof and reasoning, all of whom have at least ten years of teaching experience in the field. The subjects of this study were two students selected based on their thought processes, ranging from intuitive to deductive reasoning, with both providing correct and incorrect answers. Students who struggle with this transition tend to rely on institutional and evaluative assurances. One of the causes is the limited availability of teaching materials that support the development of higher-order thinking skills. This study aims to develop a product in the form of a mathematics module that combines the Problem Based Learning (PBL) approach with the assistance of Augmented Reality (AR) technology to improve students' creative thinking skills. This study adopted the ADDIE development model which includes five steps including Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation. The subjects of this study were 12th-grade students at a high school in Cirebon Regency. The results showed that the developed module received validation from material experts of 87% and from media experts of 85.3%, both of which are included in the very valid category. This module was also considered practical with a practicality score reaching 84.6%. The effectiveness of the module is seen from the N-Gain value of 76%, which is included in the effective category. The development process involved needs analysis, prototype design, and implementation through Scratch, integrating contextual tasks, visual representations, and game-based activities within a single learning environment. Validation was conducted by one mathematics education expert and two experts in educational media and ICT-based learning, while usability and user acceptance were examined through a User Acceptance Test (UAT) involving 18 prospective mathematics teachers. Data were collected using validation sheets and a UAT questionnaire and analyzed using Aiken’s V coefficient and percentage-based descriptive statistics. text_snippet: RME-BASED DOODLE ART COMICS TO STRENGTHEN ELEMENTARY STUDENTS’ NUMERACY LITERACY Numeracy literacy is an essential competency that should be developed from the elementary school level to help students understand and apply mathematical concepts in daily life. However, elementary school students’ numeracy literacy remains low, especially in understanding problems, connecting numerical information, and solving contextual mathematical tasks. This condition is caused by mathematics learning that is still abstract, procedural, and less connected to students’ real-life experiences. Therefore, contextual and engaging learning media are needed to support numeracy learning. This study aims to develop a Doodle Art comic based on Realistic Mathematics Education (RME) to enhance elementary school students’ numeracy literacy. The study employed a Research and Development (R&D) method using the ADDIE model, which includes analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation stages. The research instruments included validation sheets, teacher and student questionnaires, numeracy literacy tests, observations, and interviews. title: ENHANCING SELF-REGULATED LEARNING THROUGH A CULTURE-INTEGRATED STEM FLIPPED CLASSROOM APPROACH
text_snippet: ENHANCING SELF-REGULATED LEARNING THROUGH A CULTURE-INTEGRATED STEM FLIPPED CLASSROOM APPROACH This study aims to analyze the effectiveness of integrating local cultural values into STEM learning through a Flipped Classroom model to enhance students’ self-regulated learning. This approach was developed to address the need for culturally relevant and innovative instructional designs that foster independent learning skills in the demands of 21st-century education. A quasi-experimental design was employed involving secondary school students who engaged with culturally grounded STEM materials learned independently through pre-class videos and reinforced through collaborative in-class activities. Self-regulated learning was measured using a standardized questionnaire and analyzed quantitatively. The results indicate a significant improvement in students’ planning, self-monitoring, strategy regulation, and self-evaluation after participating in the intervention. These findings suggest that integrating local cultural values into STEM learning through a Flipped Classroom model not only enhances the contextual relevance of instruction but also contributes meaningfully to the development of students’ self-regulated learning abilities.

The “Jembatan Aritmatika (Arithmetic Bridge)” e-module was designed based on an initial analysis of students’ learning obstacles, particularly in understanding equality and symbolic representations. title: A CASE METHOD–BASED MATHEMATICS MODULE INTEGRATING EAST NUSA TENGGARA ETHNOMATHEMATICS FOR NUMERACY LITERACY
text_snippet: A CASE METHOD–BASED MATHEMATICS MODULE INTEGRATING EAST NUSA TENGGARA ETHNOMATHEMATICS FOR NUMERACY LITERACY Improving students' numeracy literacy requires mathematics learning that is contextual, meaningful, and connected to students' cultural experiences. This study aimed to develop a case method–based mathematics learning module integrating East Nusa Tenggara ethnomathematics to improve students' numeracy literacy. The study employed a Research and Development (R&D) approach using the ADDIE model. The module was validated by two subject-matter experts and two media experts, while its practicality was evaluated through teacher and student response questionnaires. Its effectiveness was examined using a one-group pre-test–post-test design, analyzed with a paired-samples t-test and Cohen's d effect size. The subject-matter experts assigned validation scores of 4.6 for content accuracy, 4,8 for ethnomathematics content, 4,7 for instructional strategy, and 3,9 for language, indicating that module was valid to very valid. The media experts assigned scores of 4,4 for visual design, 4,3 for layout, and 4,9 for usability, indicating that the module was very valid. title: PENGEMBANGAN MEDIA AUGMENTED REALITY BERBASIS PJBL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KREATIF SISWA MISOOL SELATAN
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN MEDIA AUGMENTED REALITY BERBASIS PJBL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KREATIF SISWA MISOOL SELATAN Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan media pembelajaran Augmented Reality (AR) berbasis Project Based Learning (PJBL) untuk meningkatkan kemampuan berpikir kreatif siswa sekolah dasar di Misool Selatan. Latar belakang penelitian adalah rendahnya kemampuan berpikir kreatif siswa, terlihat dari hasil tes awal yang hanya 20% siswa mencapai ketuntasan, serta pembelajaran masih didominasi metode konvensional yang kurang interaktif. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode Research and Development (R&D) dengan model pengembangan ADDIE yang meliputi tahap analisis, desain, pengembangan, implementasi, dan evaluasi. Subjek penelitian adalah siswa kelas V SD Negeri 15 Fafanlap dengan uji coba kelompok kecil sebanyak 10 siswa dan uji coba kelompok besar sebanyak 20 siswa. Instrumen penelitian terdiri dari lembar validasi ahli materi dan ahli media, angket respon siswa, serta tes pretest dan posttest kemampuan berpikir kreatif. text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN DESAIN PEMBELAJARAN STEAM UNTUK MEMFASILITASI BERPIKIR KRITIS SISWA: PENDEKATAN INOVATIF PENDIDIKAN ABAD 21 Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan desain model pembelajaran STEAM yang secara spesifik dirancang untuk memfasilitasi kemampuan berpikir kritis siswa dalam konteks Pendidikan abad 21. Keterbatasan pembelajaran konvensioanal dalam mengembangkan kemampuan brpikir kritis, pendekatan STEAM dipilih sebagai kerangka inovatif yang integrative dan berbasis masalah nyata. Subjek penelitian siswa kelas VIII SMP Negeri Sekampung berjumlah 32 siswa. Intrumen penelitian adalah angket untuk uji validitas dan uji kepraktisan, lembar observasi untuk pelaksanaan pembelajaran STEAM dan tes untuk kemampuan berpikir kritis. title: PENGEMBANGAN E-LKPD BERBANTUAN LIVEWORKSHEETS UNTUK MENINGKATKAN PEMAHAMAN KONSEP BARISAN DAN DERET ARITMATIKA
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN E-LKPD BERBANTUAN LIVEWORKSHEETS UNTUK MENINGKATKAN PEMAHAMAN KONSEP BARISAN DAN DERET ARITMATIKA Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya pemahaman konsep matematika siswa akibat pembelajaran yang masih didominasi metode konvensional serta belum optimalnya pemanfaatan media pembelajaran interaktif. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengembangkan Lembar Kerja Peserta Didik Elektronik (E-LKPD) berbantuan Liveworksheets yang valid, praktis, dan efektif untuk meningkatkan pemahaman konsep matematika siswa kelas X di SMAN 1 Padang Bolak Julu pada materi barisan dan deret aritmetika. text_snippet: DIGITALISASI PEMBELAJARAN MATEMATIKA KONTEKSTUAL: PENGEMBANGAN FLIPBOOK ETNOMATEMATIKA BANGUN DATAR DENGAN KEARIFAN LOKAL PONTIANAK Potensi etnomatematika di Kota Pontianak belum banyak dimanfaatkan dalam proses pembelajaran.
